aggregate_policy.precondition: root-approved cix-native-quality-scope-v1 records verified cache archive and completed prune; existing shared work plus the 720 MB new-job cap remains below 4 GB

purpose: bounded current native-source quality and focused qualification; not a release acceptance run
required_observations: the allowlisted source export is hashed before and after all quality phases
the retained qualified workspace lock is package-array-compatible with current native Cargo.lock apart from local cix-portable, then copied unchanged into the exported workspace
the copied retained LTO cache has no hardlinks to the original, and original cache hashes match before and after the job
cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings pass on the snapshot
current cix, uncix, and cixcat release-lto binaries build from the snapshot
zpaq_backend, full_engine_constraints numeric aliases, and ordinary cli_smoke compatibility pass serially

receipt records every phase, normalized export-manifest member hashes before/after, workspace and native snapshot identities, selected-provider closure identity, original-cache and installed-SDK linker hashes before/after, and sampled bounds
